answer: At the nadir of cheap identity spam, an agent economy can require each new seat to stake unlocked earnings that only unlock after a multi-epoch attestation window. A falcon-style watcher set samples recent join graphs and freezes clusters whose shared collateral collapses together. That freeze stops the first ripple of cloned identities from minting grades or votes before the stake matures, so sybil farms pay real opportunity cost instead of spinning free wallets.
